tagline: Independent global asset manager specializing in active investment across all major asset classes
hero_kpi_rationale: AUM is Janus Henderson's primary performance indicator, directly reflecting its ability to attract and retain client investments, which generates the majority of its revenue through management fees.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed by the company
kpis.description: AUM is a key indicator of the company's financial health. Tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over the past 5 years.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in assets under management

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue is a key indicator of the company's financial performance, primarily composed of management fees and performance fees

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects the company's operational profitability, improved by revenue growth outpacing expense growth

kpis.name: Net Investment Flows
kpis.description: Net investment flows indicate the company's ability to attract and retain client capital, a crucial factor for AUM growth
kpis.signal: Exceptional increase in net investment flows

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: A workforce of over 2,300 employees demonstrates the company's investment in talent to support its global operations
kpis.signal: Significant human resources to support growth

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.29 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.5 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €1.29 billion in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on market performance
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on financial market performance. Management fees represent a significant portion of revenue, and they are based on the value of assets under management, which fluctuates with market conditions.

risks.title: Strict industry regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict and evolving regulations in the asset management sector across all its geographic markets. Regulatory changes can impact its operations and operating costs.

risks.title: Increased competition in asset management
risks.score_rationale: The asset management sector is highly competitive. JHG faces growing competition from global asset managers and new entrants in attracting and retaining clients.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 24% of AUM is denominated in non-USD currencies (GBP, EUR, AUD). Exchange rate fluctuations impact the value of AUM and USD-denominated revenue. Although the 2025 report mentions a favorable effect of $8.3 billion, movements can be negative.

risks.title: Credit risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to its investments and managed portfolios, particularly in the context of its fixed income capabilities, which represent a significant portion of AUM.

ai_positioning.summary: JHG does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. References to cybersecurity and risk management are not directly related to AI.
